subject: Request: outcomes brief & permission to use Sproutly metrics for renewal
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sproutlylabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: outcomes brief & permission to use Sproutly metrics for renewal

Hi Lena —

Hope you’re well. We’ve started preparing materials for the upcoming renewal conversation (target week of 12/14) and would love to include a concise outcomes brief that highlights the business impact Sproutly has seen on Redwood. Specifically we’re proposing a one-page summary with: a short numerical highlight (latency down 35%, inference cost per 1M tokens down 18%), a screenshot of the usage dashboard, and a 1–2 sentence quote from a Sproutly exec.

Would you be comfortable if we included those metrics and a short quote from you or Maya in the reference pack we share with our internal renewal committee and, if useful, on a short case study later? I’ve attached a draft one-pager for review and a dashboard screenshot stub so you can see the layout.

Attachments: sproutly_outcomes_onepager_v1.pdf (stub), usage_dashboard_q4.png (stub)

If it helps, we can send a precise suggested quote and the final one-pager for quick sign-off — no public press release unless you want it. Let me know any edits or privacy constraints.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

On Mon, Dec 1, 2026 at 09:14 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Initial request for outcomes brief and permission to use metrics for renewal materials.
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sproutlylabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@sproutlylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: outcomes brief & permission to use Sproutly metrics for renewal

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the note and for putting this together. We’re open to being a reference for Redwood and to the outcomes brief in the context of the renewal conversation. A couple of quick asks before we sign off:

- Can you send the exact one-sentence quote you plan to attribute to Sproutly? We’ll edit for tone but want visibility.
- Please mark where the dashboard screenshot will be cropped — we can redact any customer IDs.
- We prefer the materials to be shared with procurement/legal at Sproutly before anything goes public.

If you send the finalized one-pager, I’ll route to our internal stakeholders and aim to confirm by Thursday.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Data Products, Sproutly Labs
lena.ortiz@sproutlylabs.com

On Mon, Dec 1, 2026 at 09:14 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick reply — appreciate it.
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sproutlylabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: outcomes brief & permission to use Sproutly metrics for renewal

Hi Lena —

Attached is the updated one-pager (v1) and the dashboard screenshot cropped to remove any internal IDs. I also drafted a short suggested quote below to speed review: 

"Redwood helped us reduce inference latency and cost while making it easier to scale models into production — we saw a 35% reduction in tail latency and roughly 18% unit cost savings during Q3."

If you prefer different phrasing, feel free to edit directly and send back. We’ll only use the finalized sentence in the renewal pack and will not publish without your explicit OK.

Attachments: sproutly_outcomes_onepager_v1.pdf, usage_dashboard_q4.png

Quick logistics: Rishi and I are aligning on the renewal package — the ask we’re pitching internally is Dedicated capacity + 24/7 support. If there are any internal procurement points we should know about, please flag them.

Thanks again,
Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:20 AM Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sproutlylabs.com> wrote:
> Happy to review — sending to our team now.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:50:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: positioning details for Sproutly renewal

Team — quick internal note while Lena reviews:

- The two metrics Monica listed are our strongest differentiators for this account. If possible, confirm the underlying numbers: what timeframe is the 35% latency reduction tied to (initial deployment vs. post-optimizations)? Can we call out % fewer infra nodes or $ savings/month?
- Marketing (Ben): can you draft a 2-paragraph mini-case-study from the one-pager and prepare a short quote video ask (15–30s) for Lena?
- I’ll schedule a 30-min prep with procurement/finance to make sure PROC has the right numbers for the deal ask (Dedicated + 24/7).

Cc’ing Monica for the customer approvals flow. Will sync after Lena confirms.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 08:05 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sent the draft one-pager and suggested quote — awaiting sign-off.
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sproutlylabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@sproutlylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: outcomes brief & permission to use Sproutly metrics for renewal

Monica —

Thanks for the draft. We reviewed internally and can approve the one-pager and the metrics for use in the renewal packet. A few tiny edits to the quote — we prefer: 

"Working with Redwood Inference reduced our inference tail latency by ~35% and lowered our per-token inference cost by ~18%, enabling us to scale higher-value models without a proportional increase in cost."

I’ve attached our signed consent form for reference (no-publication clause checked — internal and partner-only use okay). We’re happy to be a reference for procurement calls. If you want the brief public later, we’ll need an explicit PR approval flow.

Attachments: sproutly_reference_consent_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Data Products, Sproutly Labs

Subject: Internal: Sproutly approved — prep reference pack

Ben — great news, Lena signed the consent (attached). Can you do the following?

1) Convert the one-pager into a 2-paragraph mini-case-study.
2) Prep a short script and ask for a 20–30s recorded quote (we’ll provide suggested lines but will mark the approved wording).
3) Drop final assets into the Drive folder and include a single HTML summary we can attach to the renewal packet.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/1772
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEfGHijk_Sproutly-Reference-Pack

I’ll follow up with Procurement on the numbers Rishi asked for and loop in Legal if we want to move to any public case study.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
